name: North American QSO Party, SSB
notes: Rules from the sponsor's own document: 'Rules: 2026 North American QSO Party (CW/SSB/RTTY)', NCJ (National Contest Journal), printed NCJ October/November 2025, fetched from ncjweb.com 2026-07-27 and read verbatim - one document governs all three NAQP modes, and this party is its SSB event. NOT A STATE QSO PARTY: NAQP is deliberately absent from the State QSO Party Challenge approved list, appears under 'not approved' in the dashboard, and adds nothing to the Challenge score. TWO RUNNINGS IN 2026, both windows shipped (Article 19, target year only): 1800 UTC 17 January to 0559:59 UTC 18 January, already past, and 1800 UTC 15 August to 0559:59 UTC 16 August. The rules pin the endpoint exactly - 'The contest period ends at 05:59:59 UTC'. Single ops may operate at most 10 of the 12 hours with 30-minute minimum off-times, which this app does not track. EXCHANGE IS NAME + LOCATION AND NOTHING ELSE - no RST, no serial: 'Operator name and station location (state, province, or country) for North American stations; operator name only for non-North American stations', one name for the whole contest. ONE POINT PER VALID CONTACT, one legal mode ('SSB only'), stations worked once per band. MULTIPLIERS COUNT AGAIN ON EACH BAND: all 50 US states plus DC - DC IS ITS OWN MULTIPLIER, never aliased to MD - the standard 13 Canadian provinces/territories (NL spelling), and the 46-of-47 other-NA-country list generated by gen_naqp.py from the sponsor's own paper-log multiplier checklist joined to the ARRL DXCC List (January 2026 edition), which rules 3 and 11 designate by name. The country list rides in the county slot (the BCQP precedent), so every country validates exactly and counts per band; the sponsor's checklist prints the state rows WITHOUT DC while rule 11 grants it, and the rules win. Your own state counts - nothing is excluded. Non-NA stations, maritime mobiles and aeronautical mobiles are QSO credit only, 'entered as DX in the received location field', which the dx-token-with-no-dx-class shape reproduces: DX is loggable, pays its point, never multiplies. Cuba is CM on the sponsor's checklist - typing CO credits Colorado. NO bonus stations, NO final-score multipliers; QRP and Low Power are entry categories (over 100 W is reclassified a check log). Bands 160/80/40/20/15/10 m. Cabrillo CONTEST header NAQP-SSB per the WA7BNM registry (Article 1 exception - the rules print no token). Logs due within 7 days (SSB August: 0600 UTC August 23) at ncjweb.com/naqplogsubmit; paper logs via b4h.net/cabforms/naqpssb_cab.php. Contest manager: Bill Lippert, AC0W, ssbnaqpmgr@ncjweb.com. Not modelled, deliberately: the 10-of-12-hour off-time accounting, M2's 10-minute band timer (rule 5C(vi)), and the sponsor-side NIL/bust penalty arithmetic of rule 12. Nothing may follow the last marked item below: the caveats pass (gen_caveats.py) copies each item's body from the notes, and a trailing paragraph would ride along into the last caveat's detail. KNOWN LIMITATION 1: A DOMINICAN REPUBLIC CONTACT IS CREDITED AS HAWAII, AND THE SCORE IS A FLOOR WHEN BOTH ARE WORKED ON ONE BAND. The sponsor's own multiplier checklist prints HI twice - among the states (Hawaii, a state by rule 3) and among the other-NA countries (Dominican Republic, ARRL DXCC list). One token cannot be two multipliers in this app; the state table wins, so a received HI always credits Hawaii, the Dominican Republic is omitted from the country list, and working both KH6 and an HI3 on the same band earns two multipliers from the sponsor but one here - at most one multiplier per band low, only when both are worked. The sponsor's log checker resolves the token by callsign; this app cannot. KNOWN LIMITATION 2: AN ENTRANT OUTSIDE NORTH AMERICA GETS NO VALID-CONTACT FILTERING FOR CONTACTS WITH OTHER NON-NA STATIONS, which rule 12 excludes by requiring that a valid contact be 'between a North American station and any other station'. Such an entrant sets their location to DX and logs normally; a non-NA-to-non-NA row is credited here and would be removed by the sponsor. This party has no home region, so setup asks one question - your location - and takes your state, province, NA country prefix, or DX; whatever you enter is what the Cabrillo LOCATION header carries. Does not affect a US or Canadian entrant. KNOWN LIMITATION 3: THE CHECKLIST TOKEN '4U1/u' SHIPS AS 4U1, because '/' is reserved for county-line entry and cannot be typed in the exchange field. Log United Nations HQ as 4U1; the other 4U1 station (4U1WB, World Bank, Washington DC) sends DC and is unaffected.
